title: What Is a Reorg in the Bitcoin Blockchain?
hook: Can Bitcoin's chain change its mind? Sometimes, locally.

scenes.narration: A node finds a chain with more total work that leaves out blocks it had accepted.
A reorg is local to each node, not a network-wide vote.

cta: Seen one on a block explorer? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: A reorg is when a node switches to a heavier chain that excludes blocks it had accepted.
